hunks.baseline: The sand on the hill slowly slipped downward. It was a sweltering day without a breath of wind. Beneath the blazing sun, the shadows of flying beasts fell over everyone.
hunks.sol: Sand slipped slowly down the hillside. The day was sweltering, without a breath of wind. Beneath the blazing sun, the shadows of flying beasts passed over everyone’s heads.

hunks.baseline: A dozen or so vultures glided through the sky, letting out cries like screams.
hunks.sol: A dozen or so vultures glided through the sky, their cries almost like screams.

hunks.baseline: Their enormous wings, spanning several meters, were nothing but bare white bones. And the eyes gazing down from far above weren’t made of flesh and blood—they glowed a vivid blue.
hunks.sol: Their enormous wings, spanning several meters, were nothing but bare white bones. The eyes gazing down from far above were not made of flesh and blood. They burned with a vivid blue light.

hunks.baseline: The kind of light that might shine in the eyes of something returned from the edge of death.
hunks.sol: The gaze of something returned from the edge of death.

hunks.baseline: A being that hovered somewhere between life and death.
hunks.sol: Something caught between life and death.

hunks.baseline: A voice like a sigh slipped from someone’s lips.
hunks.sol: The word escaped someone’s lips like a sigh.

hunks.baseline: But not one of the many people watching the vultures fly over their heads and on toward the horizon looked afraid.
hunks.sol: Yet none of the people watching the vultures fly overhead and on toward the horizon looked afraid. They already knew the undead monsters weren’t their enemies.

hunks.baseline: They already knew.
Those undead monsters weren’t their enemies.

hunks.baseline: And at least one of them thought of him as more than an ally. He was a friend.
hunks.sol: And some of them thought of him as more than an ally. He was a friend.

hunks.baseline: “Fuck. I’m not doing this anymore.”
hunks.sol: “Fuck it. I’m done.”

hunks.baseline: “Then shut your mouth, you lunatic. You think this is some cheap Familiar like the ones humans like you use?”
hunks.sol: “Then shut your mouth, you lunatic. Do you think this is some cheap Familiar like the ones humans use?”

hunks.baseline: The human and monster traded words as casually as old friends, then fixed their gazes on the heat haze shimmering over the desert.
hunks.sol: The human and the monster spoke as casually as old friends while staring into the heat haze shimmering over the desert.

hunks.baseline: They could feel the vibrations slowly crumbling the sand dunes.
hunks.sol: Beneath them, vibrations slowly crumbled the sand dunes.

hunks.baseline: “No, actually, I finished a little while ago.”
hunks.sol: “No. Actually, I finished a little while ago.”

hunks.baseline: “To build the suspense.”
hunks.sol: “To build suspense.”

hunks.baseline: “Yeah.”
hunks.sol: “Yes.”

hunks.baseline: That was an enormous army.
hunks.sol: An enormous army.

hunks.baseline: And that was only what they’d confirmed so far. If they somehow counted the exact number, it might be far beyond their estimate.
hunks.sol: And that was only how many the Skeleton King had confirmed. The true number might be far higher.

hunks.baseline: “Fuck, they’re really going all in.”
hunks.sol: “Fuck. They really went all out.”

hunks.baseline: “I still don’t know. From above, there are about three that look like serious threats, but whether one of them is The Prophet… Hmm.”
hunks.sol: “I still don’t know. There are about three on the ground that look dangerous even from above, but whether one of them is The Prophet… Hmm.”

hunks.sol: He let out a sudden groan, his face stiffening.

hunks.baseline: “Are they all S-rank?”
hunks.sol: “All S-rank?”

hunks.baseline: “Probably. My servants couldn’t even fight back before they were defeated.”
hunks.sol: “Probably. My servants were taken out before they could do a thing.”

hunks.baseline: The news that four S-rank monsters had led an army of tens of thousands right to their doorstep shook the nearly one thousand Hunters. No matter how carefully selected and battle-hardened they were, they couldn’t simply cast aside their fear of death.
hunks.sol: The news that four S-rank monsters had led an army of tens of thousands right to their doorstep shook the nearly one thousand Hunters. However carefully selected and battle-hardened they were, they couldn’t simply stop fearing death.

hunks.baseline: The vibrations grew more and more violent. As the sand shifted beneath their feet, the Hunters’ eyes trembled.
hunks.sol: The vibrations grew stronger. The Hunters’ gazes trembled as they watched the sand shift beneath their feet.

hunks.baseline: They could already picture the countless monsters about to surge in like a wave.
hunks.sol: They could almost see the countless monsters about to surge toward them like a wave.

hunks.baseline: They could picture their comrades—or themselves—spattered with blood and dying amid the monsters’ roars and the fierce battle.
hunks.sol: And amid the monsters’ roars and the fierce fighting, they could see their comrades—or themselves—dying in sprays of blood.

hunks.baseline: And it was right then that a calm voice reached everyone’s ears.
hunks.sol: Then a calm voice reached them.

hunks.baseline: One by one, the people who’d been looking down raised their heads. Jin Taekyung stood on the hill, gazing at them with eyes sunk deep and steady.
hunks.sol: One by one, those who’d been staring at the ground raised their heads. Jin Taekyung stood on the hill, watching them with a steady, solemn gaze.

hunks.baseline: “No, I suppose we should call it running away, not retreating. Right?”
hunks.sol: “No. I guess we should call it running away, not retreating. Right?”

hunks.baseline: “Honestly, whether you call it a strategic retreat or running away, I can’t blame you. Everyone wants to survive. We all have reasons to keep living, even if we have to run like hell to do it.”
hunks.sol: “Honestly, whether you call it a strategic retreat or running away, I can’t blame you. Everyone wants to survive. Everyone has a reason to keep living, even if they have to run like hell to do it.”

hunks.baseline: That was true of everyone in the world.
hunks.sol: That was true of everyone.

hunks.baseline: They had family bound to them by blood, and friends who felt like family even without the blood. And even if they had neither, they still had reasons to keep living.
hunks.sol: People had family bound to them by blood, and friends who were family in all but blood. Even those who had neither still had reasons to go on living.

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know where it came from, but there’s a saying: There’s no paradise at the end of the road when you run away.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know where I heard it, but there’s a saying: There’s no paradise where you end up after running away.”

hunks.baseline: The sunlight pouring down overhead was hot enough to set them on fire, yet the moment they heard Jin Taekyung’s voice, they felt as if someone had doused them in cold water.
hunks.sol: The sun overhead was hot enough to set them on fire, yet the moment they heard Jin Taekyung’s voice, a chill went through them as though they’d been doused in cold water.

hunks.baseline: There was no paradise at the end of the road when you ran away. They lived in a time like that.
hunks.sol: There was no paradise waiting at the end of a retreat. That was the age they lived in.

hunks.baseline: “Run away, and run away, and run away again… Then one day, after fighting tooth and nail to survive, you look around. Will there still be anything left for you to protect?”
hunks.sol: “Run, and run, and keep running… Then one day, after doing everything you can to stay alive, you look around. Will there be anything left for you to protect?”

hunks.baseline: It had been more than thirty years.
hunks.sol: It had been some thirty years.

hunks.baseline: Humanity had rebuilt cities even larger and more splendid on the ruins left behind by the Great Cataclysm. The traces of that disaster remained only in records and scars.
hunks.sol: Humanity had rebuilt bigger, grander cities on the ruins left by the Great Cataclysm. The disaster’s traces remained only in records and scars.

hunks.baseline: Those who survived the war, or were born after peace arrived, didn’t know what war was like.
hunks.sol: Those who had survived the war, and those born only after peace arrived, no longer knew war.

hunks.baseline: Combat and war were different. So were Gates and reality.
hunks.sol: A battle was not a war. A Gate was not the real world.

hunks.baseline: In the Gates they’d experienced until now, they could simply retreat to avoid a fight. But the place they were standing in at that very moment was the world where they’d been born and raised.
hunks.sol: In the Gates they’d faced until now, they could retreat to avoid a fight. But the place where they stood now was the world where they’d been born and raised.

hunks.baseline: A world with something they had to protect.
hunks.sol: A world that held things they wanted to protect.

hunks.baseline: A world they had to protect, no matter what.
hunks.sol: A world they had to defend.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung knew that. From the day he survived alone, leaving behind someone who’d been like an older brother, to now, when he’d come to know another world.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung had known that since the day he survived alone, leaving behind someone who’d been like an older brother. He knew it still, now that he’d come to know another world.

hunks.baseline: “If there’s something you want to protect, fight for it with your life on the line. That’s why you’re all here, isn’t it?”
hunks.sol: “If there’s something you want to protect, put your life on the line and fight. That’s why you’re here, isn’t it?”

hunks.baseline: Everyone wondered, but no one knew.
Why the cursed monsters had invaded this world, or how humans had come to possess such incredible power.
hunks.sol: Everyone wondered, but no one knew why the cursed monsters had invaded this world—or how humans had come to possess such incredible power.

hunks.baseline: But everyone had some vague idea.
hunks.sol: But they all had some inkling.

hunks.baseline: This power that had come to them one day like a stroke of luck had been given to them so they could protect this world from monsters.
hunks.sol: The power that had come to them one day like a stroke of luck had been given to them to protect this world from monsters.

hunks.baseline: Sand whipped around Jin Taekyung. A hot wind blew in from somewhere and swept over the people.
hunks.sol: Sand whipped around Jin Taekyung. A hot wind blew in from somewhere and swept over the Hunters.

hunks.baseline: It thawed their hands and feet, frozen like ice even beneath the sweltering sun, and made the red blood in their veins boil—unlike the monsters now appearing in the distance beside a gigantic sandstorm.
hunks.sol: It thawed their hands and feet, frozen despite the scorching sun, and set the red blood in their veins boiling—blood unlike that of the monsters now emerging in the distance through a vast sandstorm.

hunks.baseline: An immensely powerful wave of energy jolted everyone’s senses awake. As Jin Taekyung slowly turned around, heat haze rose around him.
hunks.sol: An immense wave of qi jolted everyone alert. Heat haze rose around Jin Taekyung as he slowly turned.

hunks.baseline: The heat was so intense that it made the space around him seem to warp.
hunks.sol: The heat was so intense that the space around him seemed to warp.

hunks.baseline: The spearhead gleaming in the sunlight blazed like a blue-white sun.
hunks.sol: His spearhead caught the sunlight and blazed like a blue-white sun.

hunks.baseline: Countless weapons were drawn at once, as if on cue.
hunks.sol: Countless weapons came free at once, as if on cue.

hunks.baseline: When Magic Johnson raised his staff, dozens of transport vehicles, each weighing several tons, blocked the way ahead.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson raised his staff, and dozens of transport vehicles, each weighing several tons, moved across their front to form a barricade.

hunks.baseline: A steel wall took shape with a series of heavy thuds.
hunks.sol: A wall of steel took shape amid heavy thuds.

hunks.baseline: Raising a vast cloud of sand, a wave of monsters rushed fiercely across the boundless desert.
hunks.sol: A wave of monsters raced across the boundless desert, throwing up a vast cloud of sand.

hunks.baseline: But Jin Taekyung’s words as he watched them were so calm and matter-of-fact, they surprised everyone.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung watched them come. His next words were so matter-of-fact that they took everyone by surprise.

hunks.baseline: “Fuck. Hang in there, everyone. We’re going to bust our fucking asses killing all those bastards.”
hunks.sol: “Fuck. Hang in there, everyone. Killing all those bastards is going to be a real pain in the ass.”

hunks.baseline: Someone burst out laughing.
A Hunter who’d been staring at the comrade beside him as if he’d gone insane let out a snort, and soon everyone’s shoulders were shaking.
hunks.sol: Someone burst out laughing. A Hunter who’d been staring at the comrade beside him as if he’d gone mad let out a short laugh, too. Soon everyone’s shoulders were shaking.

hunks.baseline: Kill them all? All those monsters?
hunks.sol: *Kill them all? Every last one of those monsters?*

hunks.baseline: Normally, they’d have thought it was absurd nonsense.
If anyone else had said it, no matter how great a Hunter they were, they’d have cursed them under their breath.
hunks.sol: Ordinarily, they’d have called it absurd nonsense. If anyone else had said it—no matter how great a Hunter—they’d have cursed him under their breath.

hunks.baseline: The only one writing another legend after Cheon Taemin.
hunks.sol: The only person writing a new legend after Cheon Taemin.

hunks.baseline: They couldn’t help believing in him.
Jin Taekyung had always fought at the very front, harder than anyone else.
hunks.sol: They couldn’t help believing him. Jin Taekyung had always fought at the very front, harder than anyone else.

hunks.baseline: Even as the thunderous rumbling and roars grew loud enough to make their eardrums throb, the Hunters couldn’t keep from laughing.
hunks.sol: Even as the rumbling and roars swelled until their eardrums throbbed, the Hunters couldn’t stop laughing.

hunks.baseline: They watched Jin Taekyung stand tall on the sand dune like a mountain, then swing his spear.
hunks.sol: From the sand dune, where he stood as solid as a mountain, Jin Taekyung swung his spear.

hunks.baseline: Blood erupted like a fountain and evaporated before it could touch the ground. Torn bodies and entrails scattered in every direction.
hunks.sol: Blood shot up like a fountain and evaporated before it touched the ground. Torn bodies and entrails scattered in every direction.

hunks.baseline: The opening moment of the great battle that would later be called the Desert Storm.
hunks.sol: It was the opening moment of the great battle that would later be called the Desert Storm.

hunks.baseline: The cigar he’d taken—or, rather, acquired—from the French President not long ago was still slowly burning.
hunks.sol: The cigar he’d taken—or rather, acquired—from the French President not long ago was still burning down.

hunks.baseline: He’d heard later that it had been a direct gift from Michael Silbert. Given its provenance, it was obviously worth a fortune.
hunks.sol: He’d since heard it had been a gift from Michael Silbert himself. Given where it came from, it was obviously worth a fortune.

hunks.baseline: The monster wave that began in the center of Cuba’s capital had grown beyond control. It ended only after sinking three island nations in the Cayman Islands deep beneath the sea.
hunks.sol: The monster wave that began in the heart of its capital had grown beyond control. It ended only after three island nations in the Cayman Islands had sunk deep beneath the sea.

hunks.baseline: When a certain middle-aged man, who’d never even touched tobacco, began smoking cigars out of habit.
hunks.sol: When a certain middle-aged man who’d never touched tobacco began smoking cigars out of habit.

hunks.baseline: Ash that had been burning for a long time dropped with a soft *tap*.
hunks.sol: A long column of ash broke off and fell with a soft *tap*.

hunks.baseline: After watching it in silence for a long while, Chuck Hagel abruptly spoke.
hunks.sol: Chuck Hagel watched it in silence for a while before speaking.

hunks.baseline: An aide, who’d just waved the thick cigar smoke away, answered.
hunks.sol: His aide waved away the thick cigar smoke before answering.

hunks.baseline: The aide barely swallowed the words that had almost slipped out and clicked his tongue.
hunks.sol: The aide barely kept the words from slipping out. He clicked his tongue instead.

hunks.baseline: “We’re fully prepared and standing by. We’re responsible for the rear of the Rub’ al Khali Desert.”
hunks.sol: “We’re fully prepared and standing by. We have the rear of the Rub’ al Khali Desert covered.”

hunks.baseline: “Damn it. That’s all well and good, but that goddamn satellite surveillance still doesn’t work. Why are the drones down? Did some defense contractor take a kickback?”
hunks.sol: “Damn it. That doesn’t make the goddamn satellite surveillance work. Why are the reconnaissance drones down? Did somebody take a kickback from the defense contractor?”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know about any of that. If anything happens to the others with that punk who ran off on his own… you know the bastards who made those fucking paper airplanes will die by my hand.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know a damn thing about that. What I do know is that if anything happens to the others with that punk who ran off on his own… the bastards who made those fucking paper airplanes will die by my hand.”

hunks.baseline: The aide was profoundly grateful that there was no one from a defense contractor around at that moment.
hunks.sol: The aide was deeply grateful that no one from a defense contractor was there to hear him.

hunks.baseline: He was also grateful that his short-tempered superior was still guarding the main force.
hunks.sol: He was grateful, too, that his short-tempered superior was still guarding the main force.

hunks.baseline: Unfortunately, the relief he felt didn’t last long.
hunks.sol: Unfortunately, his relief didn’t last long.

hunks.baseline: A sudden emergency alarm rang out, and red warning lights flashed on. Urgent shouts erupted around the command center.
hunks.sol: An emergency alarm sounded without warning, and red warning lights flashed on. Urgent shouts broke out across the command center.

hunks.baseline: A moment later, Chuck Hagel saw the aide’s face stiffen as he read the report.
hunks.sol: A moment later, Chuck Hagel saw his aide’s face stiffen as he read the report.

hunks.baseline: “…We’re under attack. Part of the search party outside has been hit.”
hunks.sol: “…An attack. Part of the search party we sent out has been hit.”

hunks.baseline: The aide paused for breath, then let it out.
hunks.sol: The aide drew a breath, then let it out.
